t0283-01.gloss: A personal trace links trial residue to illness before a later restriction.
t0283-01.rival_reading: A response team could have carried farm supplies while checking exposure; the objects and timing do not establish that the trial caused it.

t0283-02.gloss: A glass is retained after a hurried cleaning of the counter.
t0283-02.rival_reading: An ordinary sanitation check after spoiled supplies could account for the tape and bleach.
